title: Term-Count Goodwill Table, Rental Property Service Contracts Catch-Up Charges
content:
**Goodwill rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts catch-up charge for a tier upgrade carries a term-count goodwill rate set by the number of terms for which the contract carries annual premium charges.

| Annual premium charges on the contract | Term-count goodwill |
|---|---|
| for three or more terms | 0.05 |
| for exactly two terms | 0.02 |
| for one term | 0 |

**Records read.** The annual premium charges in the contract's billing history; each term billed annually carries one.

**How the goodwill acts.** The goodwill is a reduction rate on the catch-up charge. Every reduction rate the charge carries is subtracted from one in a single sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* a contract in its third annual-billed term shows three annual premium charges: 0.05. One in its second shows two: 0.02.
